whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.report_instructions: To report: Open the chat > Tap the contact's name or number at the top > Scroll to the bottom and tap 'Report'. You can choose to block them simultaneously.
whatsapp.block_instructions: To block: Open the chat > Tap the contact's name or number > Scroll down and tap 'Block'.

instagram.name: Instagram
instagram.report_instructions: To report a message: Tap and hold the specific message > Tap 'Report' > Select the appropriate reason.
instagram.block_instructions: To block a user: Go to their profile > Tap the three dots (...) in the top right > Tap 'Block'.

generic.name: General
generic.report_instructions: Use the platform's native reporting tool (usually found via a flag icon or a menu in the user's profile).
generic.block_instructions: Block the offending user immediately to prevent further contact.

evidence_checklist: Take screenshots of all abusive messages before they are deleted.
Ensure screenshots include the sender's username, profile picture, and visible timestamps.
Do not delete the messages or the chat history from your device.
Note the exact dates and times of the incidents in a separate document.
If threats are ongoing, consider recording a video of you scrolling through the chat.

critical_resources.helpline_desc: For immediate assistance regarding cybercrime, financial fraud, or severe online threats.
